questions.question: Who has become the first woman sniper of the Border Security Force (BSF) in 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Suman Kumari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Suman Kumari has become the first woman sniper of the Border Security Force (BSF) in 2024.
 
• She underwent rigorous training to master sniping skills, which is a significant achievement for women in the BSF.
 
• Her accomplishment marks a milestone for gender equality in the Indian armed forces.
 
• Suman Kumari's achievement serves as an inspiration for many other women aspiring to join the armed forces in combat roles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Border Security Force (BSF)**

 
 
• The BSF is one of the five Central Armed Police Forces of India.
 
• It was raised in the wake of the 1965 War on 1 December 1965 for ensuring the security of the borders of India and for matters connected therewith.
 
• It is a paramilitary force charged with guarding India's land border during peacetime and preventing transnational crime.
 
• It is under the administrative control of the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA).
 
 
 
• **Women in Indian Armed Forces**
 
 
• The inclusion of women in the Indian Armed Forces has been a progressive journey over the years.
 
• Women were first inducted into the Indian Army in 1992 in the officer cadre.
 
• Women have been serving in various capacities and roles, including combat roles in recent times.
 
• The Indian government has been taking significant steps to increase the participation of women in the armed forces, ensuring equal opportunities and promoting gender equality.
 
 
 
• **Sniper Training**
 
 
• Sniper training involves rigorous physical and mental preparation.
 
• It includes marksmanship, camouflage, fieldcraft, and surveillance.
 
• Snipers are trained to operate independently and require high levels of discipline, patience, and precision.
 
• This specialized training prepares them to engage targets from long distances, often in challenging conditions.

questions.question: Who took charge recently as the new Chief Election Commissioner?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Gyanesh Kumar**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Gyanesh Kumar is the current Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) of India as of February 19, 2025.
 
• He is a retired 1988-batch IAS officer from the Kerala cadre.
 
• He succeeded Rajiv Kumar, the 25th CEC, who served from May 2022 to February 2025.
 
• He was appointed under the new 2023 law, where the selection panel includes the Prime Minister, Home Minister, and Leader of Opposition.
 
• In his first address, he said that voting is the first step for nation building and encouraged people to vote.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Nasim Zaidi**__

 __
 
• **Nasim Zaidi** served as the **Chief Election Commissioner** of India before **Achal Kumar Jyoti**.
 
• He is a retired **IAS officer** of the **1976 batch** from the **Uttar Pradesh cadre**.
 
• He has also served as the **Secretary in the Ministry of Civil Aviation**.
 
 
 
• **H. S. Brahma**__
 __
 
• **H. S. Brahma** is a former **Chief Election Commissioner** of India.
 
• He is a retired **IAS officer** of the **1975 batch** from the **Andhra Pradesh cadre**.
 
 
 
• **V. S. Sampath**__
 
 
• **V. S. Sampath** is a former **Chief Election Commissioner** of India.
 
• He is a retired **IAS officer** of the **1973 batch** from the **Andhra Pradesh cadre**.

questions.question: Honourable Justice Gita Mittal was recently sworn in as the first female Chief Justice of High Court of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu & Kashmir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Honourable Justice Gita Mittal was sworn in as the first female Chief Justice of the Jammu & Kashmir High Court.
 
• Justice Gita Mittal was administered the oath of office by the Governor of Jammu & Kashmir.
 
• She succeeded Justice Ramalingam Sudhakar, who was the acting Chief Justice.
 
• Her appointment marked a significant milestone in the history of the judiciary in Jammu & Kashmir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justice Gita Mittal**:

 
 
• Prior to her appointment as Chief Justice of Jammu & Kashmir, she served as the Acting Chief Justice of the Delhi High Court.
 
• She has a distinguished career with contributions to various legal and social issues.
 
 
 
• **High Court of Jammu & Kashmir**:
 
 
• The High Court of Jammu & Kashmir was established in 1928.
 
• It has jurisdiction over the Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Female Chief Justices**:
 
 
• The appointment of female judges to high judicial positions is a step towards gender equality in the judiciary.
 
• It encourages the representation of women in the legal profession and inspires future generations.

questions.question: In June 2024, Yusuf Pathan, a former cricketer, won the Lok Sabha seat in Baharampur; which state was this constituency located in?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Baharampur is a Lok Sabha constituency located in the **Murshidabad district** of West Bengal.
 
• West Bengal has **42 Lok Sabha constituencies**, making it one of the states with significant representation in the Parliament.
 
• The region of Baharampur is historically known for its **role during the Bengal Renaissance** and has a rich cultural and political legacy.
 
• Murshidabad, where Baharampur is located, was once the capital of Bengal during the Mughal period.
 
• The constituency has been represented by various prominent leaders in Indian politics over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lok Sabha Constituencies:**

 
 
• India has a total of **543 Lok Sabha constituencies**, each representing a specific geographical area.
 
• The Lok Sabha is the **lower house of Parliament**, and members are directly elected by citizens of India.
 
• West Bengal contributes **42 seats** to the Lok Sabha, which is among the highest in India.
 
 
 
• **Murshidabad District:**
 
 
• Murshidabad is known for its historical significance as the **former capital of Bengal**.
 
• The district is famous for landmarks such as **Hazarduari Palace** and the **Katra Mosque**.
 
• It is culturally rich and has played a pivotal role in Bengal’s history.
 
 
 
• **Bengal Renaissance:**
 
 
• The Bengal Renaissance was a cultural, social, and political movement during the 19th and early 20th centuries.
 
• It marked a period of significant reform and progress in Bengal, impacting education, literature, and politics.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal Politics:**
 
 
• West Bengal has been a key player in Indian politics, with significant contributions from leaders like **Rabindranath Tagore, Subhas Chandra Bose**, and others.
 
• Political parties like the **Trinamool Congress (TMC)** and **Communist Party of India (CPI)** have historically dominated the state.
